review.notes: Full re-review of the repaired head. Gate OK (build=0 with the module header); lake env lean: five sorry warnings only; depcheck 239 roadmaps, 2360 edges, 0 problems; one-tactic probe closes none of the five statements, elaborated signatures unchanged. Previous R01 (two owners of the Borel/Fourier objects) repaired by ceding them to OperatorAlgebraDynamics D1.BorelPrefix/D1.TwistedBorel/D4.Harmonic, whose open head claims exactly those and leaves UA/PU/PUA, the multiplier comparison and the all-weight decomposition here; R02-R08 repaired; R09 (size) not. Seeded sample of fifteen targets recomputed (adversarial rows 99-133); Primet locators checked at lines 352, 403, 430-446. Five P3: the three OperatorAlgebraDynamics ids exist only at that roadmap's open revision which the pull request does not name; the DNC normalizer Check claims a scalar -1 action on the normal bundle (the actual action is B=diag(1,-1,-1,-1)=-A, J_(0,3) fixed) and the Examples line has A sending (0,0,r,r) to its negative; the negated-action wrong model of the (g_C,K)-module Check is not a Lie module (rho'([e,f])=-h vs [rho'e,rho'f]=h); AutomorphicFormsOnReductiveGroups section 2.1 is cited for the compact-finite predicate and Banach density that its head delegates to CompactGroups Layer 5 via gap:banach-gfinite-density; 9,168-line README unsplit.
